# Comparable Prices

46 comparables. Every price carries a source URL and a retrieval date. 28 were read from a live vendor page; 3 carry a recorded conflict between sources.

FX used to normalise non-INR prices: **1 USD = 83.5**, 1 EUR = 92.0, 1 JPY = 0.55 (as of 2026-10-19). Single mid-market reference. Every non-INR price in this file is flagged as FX-derived and must not be treated as a vendor-quoted INR price.

## Free substitutes — the floor problem

- **Founderhood Free** — free. Site prints '199 / month' and '649 / month' with NO currency symbol. Almost certainly USD, not INR. EXCLUDED from the INR ladder - but the TIER STRUCTURE and the free tier are real and highly relevant.
  <sub>[CURRENCY_UNCERTAIN] https://www.thefounderhood.com/pricing</sub>
- **Univation (Incubators Platform) Universities & nonprofits** — free. THE CEILING PROBLEM: a direct competitor offered FREE to universities, with $1,000 Google Ads credit. Free is an active price in this market.
  <sub>[PUBLISHED] https://www.capterra.com/p/253529/Incubators-Platform/</sub>

## Recorded conflicts (never averaged)

- **NestLens (LabelNest) Orbit OS (module page)** — CONFLICT, carried forward from Phase 0 and re-verified. The module page says Rs 29,999/month = Rs 2,99,999/year; the product page lists Scale at Rs 2,50,000/year. Rs 3,59,988 is the naive 12x annualisation, which is almost certainly NOT the vendor's real annual price.
  <sub>https://labelnest.in/nestlens</sub>
- **Envisio Starter (aggregator listing)** — CONFLICT: GetApp lists USD 400/year; SelectHub lists USD 20,000/year.
  <sub>https://www.getapp.com/operations-management-software/a/envisio/</sub>
- **Envisio Starter (selecthub listing)** — 50x discrepancy between aggregators. Never collapse.
  <sub>https://www.selecthub.com/p/strategic-planning-software/envisio/</sub>
